acceptance: Automatic transfer demonstrated at 50 % and 100 % load
text: Automatic transfer from gas to LDO on loss of gas supply pressure, from any load between minimum environmental load and base load, without unit trip; manual on-load transfer back to gas; black start is not required but start-up on LDO with grid power shall be possible. Purging and liquid fuel system recirculation to avoid coking during gas operation.
title: Fuel transfer and LDO start
